description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_우체국 소포상자 규격별 판매 현황 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 2022년도 말 기준으로 우체국 소포(택배) 상자 규격별(1호, 2호, 3호, 4호, 5호,) 우체국 판매 현황 데이터 입니다. 본 자료는 2022년 한 해 동안 우체국을 통해 접수된 표준 소포상자 규격별 이용 물량을 집계한 통계이다. 가장 많이 사용된 규격은 1호 상자(220×190×90mm)로 총 4... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 소포상자 규격별 분류, 1호 상자(소형), 3호~5호 상자(대형), 물량 합계, 2022년 기준. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
